name: dsh-git-tools
description: Git tools for the agent and a Git panel for the DSH Web UI, running git in the host process so network operations are not blocked by the agent file sandbox.

meta.title: Git tools
meta.description: Agent tools for git status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, and pull. Runs git in the Host process, so network operations work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
